paragraphs.text: Every flat in the building has a smoke alarm in the hallway. Test your alarm once a month by pressing the button until it sounds. If the alarm makes a short beep every minute, the battery needs to be replaced.
Do not leave cooking unattended, and keep tea towels and paper away from the cooker. Most fires in the building in the last five years started in kitchens.
The fire doors on each landing must be kept closed at all times. They are designed to stop smoke spreading to the stairs, which are the only escape route.
If you discover a fire, leave the building immediately and call the fire service from outside. Do not use the lift. The meeting point is the car park opposite the main entrance.
A fire alarm test takes place every Monday at 10 am. If you hear the alarm at any other time, treat it as a real emergency and leave the building.
